title: Micro-Kernel Composition Root Boundary, Transitive Mypy Hygiene & Rule 45 Singletons

edges.description: Documents the Composition Root Boundary invariant keeping domain plugins decoupled from kernel internals
Annotates interceptor chain list with strict mypy compliance
Exports HarnessPlugin subclass and module-level plugin singleton per Rule 45

claims.assertion: The micro-kernel (src/harness/kernel/) remains strictly statically typed (mypy --ignore-missing-imports with 0 errors across 37 files) as the composition root, while every first-party plugin under plugins/ must subclass HarnessPlugin and export a module-level plugin singleton per Rule 45.
